description: Conversion of dwelling into four flats 4 x 1 beds); parking; landscaping;  bin / cycle storage (part demolition of single storey rear extension)
decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development fails to deliver an appropriate mix of dwelling sizes comprising of 100% one bedroom dwellings. This fails to deliver larger family-sized units (3 bedrooms or more), contrary to the requirements of the Harrow Local Plan and the Planning Obligations SPD which seek a balanced mix across unit sizes to meet identified housing needs. As submitted, the scheme would provide a housing offer that is unduly skewed towards smaller homes and does not support local demand for family accommodation, undermining sustainable community objectives. The application therefore in conflicts with Policy DM24 of the Harrow Development Management Local Plan and the adopted Planning Obligations (S106) SPD (2013).&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposal would amount to an over-intensive use of the site which would affect the character of the area. The proposal would, therefore, be contrary to policies DM1, DM26 and DM27 of the Harrow Council Development Management Policies, July 2013 (the DMP) which, taken together seek to secure a satisfactory quantum and form of amenity space for future occupiers of residential development, and ensure that the gardens respect the character and pattern of existing development in the area.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposed development fails to provide sufficient private amenity space for future occupiers and therefore fails to comply with Policy D3, subsection D(7) and Policy D6, subsection (D) of The London Plan (2021), Policies DM1, DM26 and DM27 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the Mayor of London Supplementary Planning Guidance Housing (2016), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) which, amongst other matters, seek to ensure that developments deliver appropriate residential amenity and maximise the usability of outside amenity space.</p>
